records.title: Incorporating Interpretable Output Constraints in Bayesian Neural Networks
records.full_text_read_scope: Selected sections only, not whole-paper line-by-line examination
records.locator: §4 Definitions 4.1–4.3, Eqs.(1)–(2); §4.1 conditional output-constrained priors; §4.2 approximate inference.
records.observed_target: Low-dimensional simulations, clinical action, recidivism and credit prediction.
records.comparison_relevance: Output-support knowledge and probabilistic output constraints are established; the broad phrase support-aware probabilistic network cannot sustain novelty alone.
records.limitations: Soft approximate posterior constraint satisfaction is not equated with E3’s architectural hard inequality. A proposed new head must specify its distinct rule.

records.title: Probabilistic Forecasting Cryptocurrencies Volatility: From Point to Quantile Forecasts
records.full_text_read_scope: Selected sections only, not whole-paper line-by-line examination
records.observed_target: Next-day daily BTC realized variance from 288 intraday five-minute returns; 99 conditional quantiles.
records.comparison_relevance: Adding quantiles or probabilistic forecasts in crypto is not by itself new; a future law-based head needs a much narrower algorithmic distinction.
records.limitations: Preprint v1; no exact finite-atom U-to-sigma pushforward mechanism is identified in the examined sections. That absence is bounded, not global.

records.title: Deep learning in predicting cryptocurrency volatility
records.observed_target: Cryptocurrency volatility for Bitcoin, Ripple and Ethereum; Jordan recurrent neural network compared with SETAR and nonlinear autoregressive neural networks.
records.current_reference_relevance: Broad prior neural cryptocurrency-volatility application; no formula of centered seven-return sigma7 established from the abstract.
records.future_V3_relevance: Shows prior recurrent volatility modeling; cannot establish or refute a specific finite-support transformed conditional return law.
records.disposition: retain_as_application_context; full-method access remains needed before a mechanism-level equivalence claim

records.title: Forecast Linear Augmented Projection (FLAP): A free lunch to reduce forecast error variance
records.observed_target: Unbiased multivariate forecasts; augmented component series and projection onto a linear subspace. Empirical applications Australian tourism and FRED-MD.
records.target_definition_or_horizon_confirmed: Multivariate forecast reconciliation; no fixed crypto horizon in abstract.
records.current_reference_relevance: Linear equality reconciliation differs from E3's scalar lower-bound support projection.
records.future_V3_relevance: Useful projection antecedent; does not by itself anticipate or validate transformed sigma7 law.
records.disposition: retain_as_related_projection_method; not a matched same-task benchmark

records.title: Dual Accuracy-Quality-Driven Neural Network for Prediction Interval Generation
records.locator: arXiv abstract v4; related DOI and journal reference
records.observed_target: General regression prediction intervals with companion target-estimation and bound-estimation networks; interval loss balances width and integrity/coverage.
records.target_definition_or_horizon_confirmed: General regression; no cryptocurrency-specific horizon stated.
records.current_reference_relevance: Learned intervals differ from additive scalar point head and later residual calibration.
records.future_V3_relevance: Generic neural predictive uncertainty and trainable interval losses already have antecedents; distributions/CRPS are not established equivalent by this abstract.

records.title: An Advanced CNN-LSTM Model for Cryptocurrency Forecasting
records.observed_target: Cryptocurrency price and movement forecasts; multiple independent cryptocurrency inputs, three years of BTC/ETH/XRP data.
records.target_definition_or_horizon_confirmed: Price/movement, not a defined centered rolling seven-return volatility target; exact horizon not checked.
records.current_reference_relevance: Direct CNN-LSTM cryptocurrency-family prior, with different prediction target.
records.future_V3_relevance: Stacking CNN and LSTM or adding multiple assets is insufficient as a novelty claim.
records.disposition: retain_as_architecture_family_context; no assertion of identical output constraints

records.title: Enhanced Interpretable Forecasting of Cryptocurrency Prices Using Autoencoder Features and a Hybrid CNN-LSTM Model
records.observed_target: Bitcoin price forecasting using variational-autoencoder preprocessing features, CNN-LSTM and SHAP.
records.current_reference_relevance: Shows hybrid family plus feature learning and explanation has prior crypto applications; target differs from sigma7.
records.future_V3_relevance: VAE/SHAP alone do not substantiate a new return-law mechanism.

records.title: Attention-based CNN–LSTM for high-frequency multiple cryptocurrency trend prediction
records.full_text_read_scope: No body access; primary indexed abstract observed
records.locator: Publisher title, abstract and author preview from indexed primary ScienceDirect result. Direct full page returned 403.
records.comparison_relevance: The architecture’s name and use in crypto are not original by themselves; this is not proof of the same phenomenon/task.
records.limitations: Body not read; no equivalence of equations, support constraint or parameter count is asserted.

records.title: Sample-Specific Output Constraints for Neural Networks
records.full_text_read_scope: Selected sections only, not whole-paper line-by-line examination
records.locator: Printed p.6816, Supported Constraints and Generalizations, final bullet; guard phi(z,s)=exp(z)+b. Method fig.1 and Eqs.(3)-(4).
records.observed_target: Facial landmark regression and vehicle follow-object control.
records.comparison_relevance: The broad floor-plus-positive-excess mechanism is already explicit. The particular bound and softplus substitution do not establish a substantive adaptation by themselves.
records.limitations: No exact E3 target or training recipe identified here. This conceptual antecedent does not prove historical copying or universal nonnovelty.

records.title: Forecasting cryptocurrency volatility
records.observed_target: Dynamic cryptocurrency volatility/density/quantile prediction; long memory, asymmetry, time-varying skewness and kurtosis; 606 cryptocurrencies.
records.current_reference_relevance: Broader financial modeling context and distributional forecasting prior; no exact centered seven-day label verified.
records.future_V3_relevance: Distributional cryptocurrency forecasting and higher moments are established ideas.
records.disposition: retain_as_distributional_volatility_context; do not identify latent volatility with observed sigma7

records.title: Cryptocurrency volatility: A review, synthesis, and research agenda
records.observed_target: Review of 164 papers from2016–December2022 covering realized/implied/stochastic volatility, stylized facts and drivers.
records.current_reference_relevance: Discovery and terminology source, not primary proof of any exact mechanism.
records.future_V3_relevance: Useful route to references; broad research gaps in a review do not certify a new algorithm.
records.disposition: retain_for_citation_discovery_only; do not substitute for primary closest-work comparison

records.title: MoFE: A Novel Mixture-of-Experts Framework with Fourier Neural Operators for Cryptocurrency Forecasting
records.locator: arXiv abstract v1; conference related DOI
records.observed_target: Bitcoin price forecasting, T+1 andT+5, with Fourier/convolution expert mixture and dynamic gating.
records.target_definition_or_horizon_confirmed: Price forecasting with statedT+1/T+5; mentions volatility conceptually but not a verified sigma7 label.
records.current_reference_relevance: Different mechanism and target; shows mixtures in cryptocurrency forecasting are not new by themselves.
records.future_V3_relevance: A finite mixture must be compared at its exact latent law and propagation rule, rather than called new because it is a mixture.
records.disposition: retain_as_mixture_crypto_neighbor; not an exact sigma7 antecedent shown here

records.title: Sentiment-driven cryptocurrency forecasting: analyzing LSTM, GRU, Bi-LSTM, and temporal attention model (TAM)
records.observed_target: Bitcoin price forecasting using Twitter sentiment (VADER/RoBERTa), LSTM/GRU/Bi-LSTM/TemporalAttention and SHAP.
records.current_reference_relevance: Temporal attention in cryptocurrency prediction is a prior family/application, with sentiment inputs and price target.
records.future_V3_relevance: Does not establish an identical support-aware volatility law; no novelty inference from its different target.

records.title: SPY Realized Variance Forecasting with Rolling Elastic Net and Duan Smearing
records.locator: SSRN abstract URL failed; search showed title/keywords but not substantive abstract
records.current_reference_relevance: Unresolved: title/keywords suggest variance and back-transformation, but this is not a method reading.
records.future_V3_relevance: Do not infer Jensen/smearing equivalence or rule it out without text.
records.disposition: unresolved_primary_access; keep in pending body/abstract followup

records.title: Comparing the forecasting of cryptocurrencies by Bayesian time-varying volatility models
records.observed_target: Forecasting cryptocurrency time series using Bayesian constant/time-varying volatility, SV and GARCH; BTC/ETH/LTC/XRP; point and density forecasts.
records.current_reference_relevance: Distributional crypto forecasts and Student-t error variants are established; exact observed target and horizon unverified.
records.future_V3_relevance: Choosing a Bayesian or Student-t distribution alone is not sufficient novelty evidence.
records.disposition: retain_as_distributional_context; no claim of exact E3 task identity
